method: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 GPU time per render (median), vsync off, seed 42, simulation paused, HUD hidden, identical camera commands and clock. Desktop 1920x1080 (quality High); phone 390x844 at DPR 2 (quality Medium, the game's own choice). Baseline = ef407c7 profile build, after = 2eaeecb profile build (code identical at 90feb5b). One preview server at a time; rounds alternate baseline then after on the same machine in the same session.
machine: Windows 11, 16 GB RAM; Chrome with ANGLE D3D11, headless

desktopRound2.note: Alternating pair (baseline run, then after run, minutes apart). The after build here is 2eaeecb (Lambert-shaded traffic).

desktopRound1.note: Full capture runs (baseline first, then after). The after build was 4957b35 (PBR-shaded traffic, before the Medium-tier change). The GPU ran faster in the after run than in the baseline run, so this round understates the cost; round 2 is the reliable pair.

phone.note: Two alternating rounds after the Medium-tier optimisation (2eaeecb).

attribution.desktopW02BeforeFloorFix: districts 0.7 ms, scenic roads 0.4 ms, terrain +0.25 ms; drawing the floor after other opaques removed the floor's overdraw (W02 5.78 -> 4.48 ms).
attribution.phoneW12bMedium: districts 0.17 ms, ambient traffic 0.13 ms (before Medium thinning), scenic roads 0.06 ms; vegetation 0.24 ms in both builds (wind is free); terrain 0.13 ms vs 0.19 ms baseline.

memory.launchThresholds: free RAM >= 3400 MB and free commit >= 4000 MB before each browser launch; abort at 900 MB RAM / 1200 MB commit
